solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Get me back among Atlantic Provinces for scholarly life

indicators.note: among means one piece sits inside the other

parts.note: Acadia was the old French colony covering Canada's Atlantic Provinces

indicators.note: back tells us to read the word me in the other direction

explanation.surface: Someone tells a friend to fetch them home to the Canadian Maritimes for a life of study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns ME into EM, which goes 'among' ACADIA, the historical name for the region of Canada's Atlantic Provinces. 'Get' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Academia is the world of universities and scholarship, the scholarly life collectively.

clue.text: Confirmation from Tokyo received in credit control meeting

indicators.note: received in means one piece is taken inside another

parts.note: hai is Japanese for yes, a confirmation heard in Tokyo

explanation.surface: A Japanese yes is heard at a meeting about credit control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'credit control meeting' reads as one business phrase, but 'credit' gives CR and 'control meeting' is the definition, a verb phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: To chair is to preside over and run a meeting, so to control it.

clue.text: Injury for old feline caught by big one overlooked by underworld god

indicators.note: in a down entry, being overlooked by something means that thing stands above, so it comes first

parts.note: Dis is the Roman god of the underworld

indicators.note: caught by means the old feline is held inside the big one

parts.note: a lion is a big cat, the big one to the feline
a cat is a feline

explanation.surface: An old cat is hurt when seized by a lion while the god of the dead looks down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'big one' continues the feline theme: a big cat swallows the old one, and in this down entry the god stands above the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A dislocation is a joint knocked out of place, a common kind of physical injury.

clue.text: Second refusal at college leads to exclusive control

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second
no is a refusal
poly is short for polytechnic, a type of British college

explanation.surface: A second rejection at college prompts someone to take complete charge.
explanation.walkthrough: POLY is short for polytechnic, a former type of British college offering degrees. 'at' and 'leads to' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: A monopoly is sole possession or control of a market or thing, shutting everyone else out.

clue.text: Father had potato mashed without delay

indicators.note: mashed suits the potato and tells us the letters are pulped into a new order

explanation.surface: Dad made himself some mashed potato.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means instantly, at the slightest signal, so with no delay at all.

clue.text: Secret observation shows pies cooked, all with shortening

indicators.note: cooked suits pies and tells us their letters are rearranged
with shortening means the word all loses its final letter

parts.note: the word all as written before trimming

explanation.surface: A baking report: the pies came out well, all made with shortening fat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shortening' is a baking fat, which suits the pies, but here it means cutting ALL to AL; 'cooked' turns PIES into ESPI.
explanation.definitionFit: Espial is the act of spying or catching sight of something, secret watching.

clue.text: Team-mate soars, almost finding net

indicators.note: in a down entry, soaring means the letters run upwards, read backwards
almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: a partner is a team-mate

explanation.surface: A team-mate leaps high and nearly hits the back of the net.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' cuts PARTNER to PARTNE, and 'soars' turns it upwards in this down entry to give the answer. 'finding' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To net is to catch or snare, which is what to trap someone means.

clue.text: Electrical activity starts beneath power plant

indicators.note: beneath in a down entry puts the following letters below, so after, the first piece

parts.note: P is the abbreviation for power in physics

indicators.note: starts means the first letters of the two words

explanation.surface: Electrical activity begins underneath a power station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'power plant' reads as a power station, but 'power' gives P and 'plant' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The pea is a climbing plant grown for its edible seeds.

clue.text: City road

definitions.meaning: a city in Alaska, the state's largest
a road, or roads, is a sheltered stretch of water where ships ride at anchor

explanation.walkthrough: 'road' here is the nautical sense, as in Hampton Roads: an offshore anchoring place.
explanation.definitionFit: Anchorage is Alaska's largest city, and an anchorage is a sheltered spot where ships moor, a roadstead.

clue.text: Dried fruit artist is available

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, the crossword's usual artist
in can mean on offer or available, as in fashion or stock

explanation.surface: A painter says that dried fruit is on offer.
explanation.definitionFit: A raisin is a dried grape, a standard dried fruit.

clue.text: Joint leader taking time amended charter

indicators.note: an amended document has been altered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A co-ruler takes time to revise a constitutional charter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'amended' rearranges the document into ETRARCH; 'Joint leader' suggests a co-chair, but a tetrarch shared a province with three others.
explanation.definitionFit: A tetrarch ruled one quarter of a province, sharing rule with others, so a joint leader.

clue.text: Hence flesh-eating giant comes round

indicators.note: comes round means the word turns about and is read from the end

parts.note: an ogre is a man-eating giant of folklore

explanation.surface: The man-eating giant comes to, so beware.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes round' sounds like waking up but turns OGRE back to front.
explanation.definitionFit: Ergo is Latin for therefore, so a word meaning hence or consequently.

clue.text: Eruption account succinctly dealt with, showing due foresight

indicators.note: dealt with means handled and so reshuffled, like a deck of cards

parts.note: AC is the short form of account

explanation.surface: Someone shows planning by handling a report of a volcanic eruption briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'succinctly' tells us to use the abbreviation AC; it and ERUPTION are shuffled by 'dealt with'. 'showing' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A precaution is a measure taken in advance against harm, foresight put into action.

clue.text: Drunken trio painted in fearful state

indicators.note: drunken means staggering about, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Three drunk people covered in paint are scared.
explanation.definitionFit: Trepidation is nervous dread, a condition of fear about what is coming.

clue.text: English students first into Paris worked last shift

indicators.note: worked means wrought or kneaded, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: L is a learner, so LL is two students

explanation.surface: English students arrive in Paris and work the late shift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first into' only says the E and LL go into the mix with PARIS; 'worked' shuffles all eight letters. 'shift' means a makeshift.
explanation.definitionFit: Pis aller is French for a last resort, a makeshift accepted when nothing better is left.

clue.text: One day hit with shivers, surgery involved in disease of unknown cause

indicators.note: involved means the surgery is wrapped up inside the other letters

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: shivers suggests shaking, so the letters are shaken into a new order

parts.note: an op is an operation, surgery

explanation.surface: A patient struck down with shivering one day needs an operation for a mystery illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with shivers' shakes the pieces into IDIATHY, and 'involved' wraps it round the surgery after the third letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiopathy is medical jargon for a disease arising spontaneously or with no known origin.

clue.text: With style and vigour antelope kicks many

indicators.note: kicks means kicks out, throws away a letter

parts.note: the eland is a large African antelope
D is the Roman numeral 500, a crossword many

explanation.surface: A lively antelope lashes out at a crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'With' is a link. 'kicks' means getting rid of D from ELAND.
explanation.definitionFit: Elan is dash or flair, energetic style and enthusiasm.

clue.text: Godmother perhaps sits on property in the Old Line State

indicators.note: sits on in a down entry means the first piece is placed above the second

parts.note: Mary is the mother of God in Christian belief; the word is split, God-mother, with perhaps showing an example
land is property, real estate

explanation.surface: A godmother perhaps owns property in an American state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Godmother' is read as Mother of God, Mary, not a baptismal sponsor.
explanation.definitionFit: The Old Line State is the traditional nickname of Maryland, from its Revolutionary War troops.

clue.text: Small room in Islington part

indicators.note: part means only a portion of these words is taken

explanation.surface: A small room forms part of a home in Islington, a district of north London.
explanation.walkthrough: 'room' and 'Islington' look like a London flat; the letters run across 'room in Islington'.
explanation.definitionFit: Mini means very small, a miniature version.

clue.text: Hypocrite finds hot spring in Peru

indicators.note: in means the hot spring sits inside Peru's letters

parts.note: PE is the international code for Peru
H is the abbreviation for hot on taps
to arise is to spring up

explanation.surface: A two-faced person finds a hot spring while visiting Peru.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hot spring' looks like a geyser but splits into H and ARISE (to spring up). 'finds' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pharisees are portrayed in the Gospels as self-righteous, so the word came to mean hypocrite.

clue.text: Rise up when king in confusion

parts.note: as can mean when, as in as I left

indicators.note: in means the king goes inside the confusion

parts.note: pie, or pi, is printers' jumbled type, a confusion
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: Rise up at a time when the king is in disarray.
explanation.walkthrough: PIE in printing is spilt, jumbled type, so a muddle.
explanation.definitionFit: To aspire originally meant to rise or mount up, as well as to aim high.

clue.text: Love treatment where some Europeans go by air

parts.note: the Spanish are some of Europe's peoples
to fly is to travel by air

explanation.surface: A romantic cure is where some Europeans take a plane.
explanation.walkthrough: 'where' is a link. The definition is a medicine for love-making, not a remedy for heartache.
explanation.definitionFit: Spanish fly is a supposed aphrodisiac made from blister beetles, a treatment to arouse love.

clue.text: Church area with piano in a corner

indicators.note: in means the piano goes inside the other letters

parts.note: SE, south-east, is one corner of a map or compass
P is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly

explanation.surface: A church area holds a piano tucked into a corner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link; SE is the south-east corner.
explanation.definitionFit: The apse is the vaulted recess at the east end of a church, behind the altar.

clue.text: Free pardon

definitions.meaning: free in the sense of left over or unoccupied
pardon as a verb, to let off or show mercy to

explanation.definitionFit: Spare means both surplus and unused, and also to let someone off punishment.

clue.text: Sea creature has first to be tamed

indicators.note: to be tamed means the letters are wild and must be brought into order

explanation.surface: A sea creature needs taming before anything else.
explanation.definitionFit: A starfish is a five-armed echinoderm, a marine animal.

clue.text: City rebellion team leader avoided

indicators.note: avoided means kept out, so the letter is dropped

parts.note: a riot is a violent uprising, a rebellion

indicators.note: leader means the first letter of team

explanation.surface: A city riot that the team's captain dodged.
explanation.definitionFit: Rio de Janeiro, the Brazilian city, is commonly shortened to Rio.

clue.text: In Paris the Harker woman turned savage

indicators.note: turned means the joined letters are read backwards

parts.note: la is French for the, with a feminine noun
Mina Harker is the heroine of Bram Stoker's Dracula

explanation.surface: In Paris, Mrs Harker turned wild.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned' reads LAMINA backwards; Mina Harker is the heroine of Dracula, a name worth knowing for crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal as an adjective means brutish or beastly, as in raw instinct, so savage.

clue.text: Compiler's angry in Indian city

parts.note: the compiler is the setter, so the setter's is my
sore can mean annoyed or angry, especially in American English

explanation.surface: The setter is cross about being in an Indian city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Mysore, now Mysuru, is a city in Karnataka, southern India.

clue.text: Set meal?

parts.note: not a fixed-price menu but food eaten in front of the television set

explanation.definitionFit: A ready meal on a tray is eaten while watching the box, a meal at the set.
